description: Virgo decan 2 (September 2 to September 12): personality, love, work and growth, with Saturn as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Virgo.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Virgo covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly September 2 to September 12, with Saturn as its sub-ruler beside Mercury. It is read as conscientious craft and slow mastery under saturn's steady discipline. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Virgo decan 2 personality
paragraphs: Saturn, the planet associated with Capricorn, is the sub-ruler of the middle decan of Virgo, and the pairing of two earth signs gives these degrees a notably serious, workmanlike character. Second-decan Virgos are often described as conscientious to the bone: they read the instructions, keep the receipts and arrive early to set up the chairs. Competence is not a performance for them but a form of self-respect. They tend to prefer slow mastery over quick wins, and they often hold quiet authority in groups simply because they have done the homework that others skipped. Promises made by this decan are usually kept.

Saturn's weight can also press down. These natives may carry responsibilities long past the point of fairness, partly because they do them well and partly because asking for help feels like an admission of failure. Pleasure is sometimes postponed until every box is ticked, and the boxes rarely run out. Older astrological texts tied this decan to endurance and to the slow ripening of skill, which fits the way many of them blossom later, once experience has caught up with their standards. A little self-permission goes a long way: the same discipline that builds careers can also protect a weekly afternoon off.

sections.heading: Virgo decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: Courtship with a second-decan Virgo is rarely hurried. They tend to observe for a while, weighing character and consistency before letting anyone close, and they take commitments as seriously as contracts. Once in, they are steady, faithful partners who turn up with soup when someone is ill and handle the paperwork nobody else wants. Feelings may be expressed through reliability more than words, which can leave a partner guessing. Regular, low-pressure check-ins, such as a Sunday walk with no agenda, often help this decan say what the steady actions have been meaning all along.

Professionally, Saturn's decan of Virgo is built for the long game. Fields with exacting standards and clear progression, such as surveying, compliance, engineering, nursing, archiving, actuarial work or skilled trades with formal apprenticeships, often reward their patience. They are the colleague who documents the process properly so the team does not repeat old mistakes. Managers tend to trust them early with serious responsibility. The hazard is quiet overload: accepting each extra task because it is reasonable on its own. Reviewing commitments every quarter, and handing some back, keeps their excellent work sustainable.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Virgo decan 2: what Saturn adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Virgo, which in most years means birthdays from September 2 to September 12. Its sub-ruler, Saturn, comes from Capricorn, the next earth sign after Virgo, so this decan borrows a little of Capricorn's character while staying Virgo at heart. The other two decans of Virgo belong to Mercury (decan 1) and Venus (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Saturn contributes discipline, patience and a sense of responsibility. Under its sub-rulership a sign is said to take itself more seriously, plan for the long term, respect structure and earn confidence slowly through steady achievement. Saturnine decans are often linked with management, craft, institutions and long apprenticeships, and their usual lesson is to allow rest and lightness alongside duty. Set against Virgo's precision, helpfulness, practical intelligence and a love of improvement, that Saturn note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Virgo decan 2
paragraphs: Much of the growth available to this decan lies in treating rest as a responsibility rather than a reward. Putting leisure into the diary, and defending it like a meeting, is a surprisingly effective first step. It can also help to notice the difference between preparing and worrying: one produces a plan, the other just repeats. Asking for help on a small task, then noticing that nothing collapses, gradually builds trust in other people. Marking milestones, even modest ones, counters the Saturnine habit of moving the finish line the moment it comes into view.

Within Virgo, decan 1 leans towards the sign's analytical engine, sharp-eyed and quietly useful and decan 3 leans towards gentle perfectionism aimed at beauty, kindness and the finishing touch. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: How does Saturn shape the second decan of Virgo?
faq.answer: Saturn, linked with Capricorn, is the sub-ruler of these middle degrees. It is traditionally read as adding discipline, endurance and a long-term focus to Virgo's precision. Second-decan Virgos are often described as conscientious, dependable and quietly authoritative, though they may need reminders that rest is part of good work.

faq.question: What are the dates of Virgo decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years September 2 to September 12, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Virgo. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Virgo decan 2?
faq.answer: Saturn. In the triplicity system each earth sign's decans take the rulers of the earth signs in order, starting with Virgo's own ruler, Mercury.
